sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed the response by WA Health to 19 recommendations about managing controlled drugs in public hospitals.
sentences.support: The purpose of this report is to review what actions have been taken in response to the Commission's recommendations.

sentences.text: The review included visits to nine hospitals and examined accountability, policies, audits, technology, drug discrepancies and staff training.
sentences.support: Commission officers attended nine regional and metropolitan hospitals and engaged directly with operational staff

sentences.text: The Commission found substantial progress but continuing differences in drug management between and within health service providers.
sentences.support: Significant variations in drug management processes and practices were evident during the Commission's review

sentences.text: The Commission closed 17 recommendations and kept two about policies and procedures open for another review after 12 months.
sentences.support: WA Health has considered and taken satisfactory action to address 17 of the 19 recommendations.

findings.quote: WA Health has considered and taken satisfactory action to address 17 of the 19 recommendations.
Significant variations in drug management processes and practices were evident during the Commission's review, not only across WA Health but also within the individual HSPs.

notes: The proposed medicines policy had been published but its implementation and practical effect were still to be reviewed at the report date.
